limits: Fixed eight parties and observed participating-action proportions; absences never become abstentions.
Reports and agendas differ across slices; distance correlation is descriptive, not invariance of matched policy items.
The 28 party pairs share parties and are not 28 independent observations; no inferential p-value is reported.
Bootstrap assumes exchangeable report clusters within each slice; repeated or linked reports may violate this assumption.
Intervals are pointwise descriptive intervals without multiple-comparison adjustment.
Unknown committee records remain in pooled/session analyses but cannot enter identified-committee comparisons.
Procrustes removes rotation/reflection and translation only, preserving scale changes; no political movement is inferred.
